# spacelift_ai_integrations (Data Source)

`spacelift_ai_integrations` represents a list of all the AI integrations in the Spacelift account visible to the API user, including the read-only ones provided by Spacelift.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spacelift_ai_integrations" "all" {}

# Only the integrations carrying every one of these labels.
data "spacelift_ai_integrations" "tagged" {
  labels = ["ai"]
}

# The filters combine, and each one is only applied when it is set: leaving
# spacelift_provided out returns both kinds, false returns only your own.
data "spacelift_ai_integrations" "own_anthropic" {
  ai_provider        = "Anthropic"
  spacelift_provided = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ai_provider` (String) Only return the integrations backed by this AI provider, one of `Anthropic`, `Bedrock`, `Google` or `OpenAI`
- `labels` (Set of String) required labels to match
- `spacelift_provided` (Boolean) Only return the integrations that are, or are not, provided by Spacelift. Leave unset to return both.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `integrations` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `ai_provider` (String)
- `base_url` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `integration_id` (String)
- `is_spacelift_provided` (Boolean)
- `labels` (Set of String)
- `models` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `provider_integration_id` (String)
- `space_id` (String)
